item.title: Miko Shibari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Karen Soft, Lapis Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2007-06-15
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巫女縛り
  • 英語名: Miko Shibari

あらすじ

Takuro is a high school teacher. He likes Miko and is a tie-up mania. One day, he receives a parcel from a friend of his. It’s a rope with magical powers. He plans to use it immediately, and finds his targets, Kanae, a female teacher, and Yuka, his student. They are sisters from a small shrine, and allowed to wear Miko uniform as campaign girls for tourism, even at school. Perfect timing for Takuro…!
